description: The European Union Agency for the Cooperation of Energy Regulators publishes this underlying dataset through its official datasets directory and AEGIS category 12. The collection accompanies Gas monitoring report 2021 and contains 1 distinct native dataitem references in the received inventory. Selected members describe Overview of EU MSs AGTM market health metrics (RSI, HHI and number of supply sources) 2016_2019. These descriptors establish gas and hydrogen system observations, costs or regulatory conditions for infrastructure research. Each member retains its own native identifier and provenance, including original providers and ACER calculations where stated. Coverage varies by member across the European markets named in the report, with historical observations and projections distinguished in their titles. The report year does not establish the acquisition date of every series. Access is through public category and member descriptions; data formats, reuse licence and charges were not established for the complete collection. Caveats include differing source methods, geographic extents and time intervals. Unclear supporting members remain flagged in the individual review ledger. The collection supports system capacity and market-operation studies and relates to the existing ACER aggregate portal record. No export or dataset file was retrieved.
